'''Renigus Wight''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] within the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was credited with the creation of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas']] [[lightning spire]]s after a lightning strike wiped out the remainder of his crew of 50, which included [[Officer/Legends|officers]], [[researcher]]s, and [[Slavery|slaves]].<ref name="Lightning spire Codex" />
